steps.what: Examine authorised operating-system or file-system artefacts using forensic tools
Investigate artefact meaning and test alternative explanations against original evidence

tasks.design: Retain investigative examination and interpretation with the analyst using existing {OTHER} forensic tools and {DOCS} notes. Existing parsing supports the work; it does not establish the cause or meaning of an artefact.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same artefact can support different explanations depending on context and source reliability.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forensic tools already expose artefacts; no distinct new labour-removal step is established.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete records, tool assumptions and distinguishing user activity from automated system behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst tests explanations and recognises what cannot be concluded.

reach.learn: Separate artefact observation from causal inference

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forensic tools can expose operating-system and file-system artefacts, but investigative meaning requires independent context and alternative explanations.

assumptions: Boundary is investigation of an existing analysis copy, excluding image acquisition, duplication and report writing.

Existing acquisition and verification process produces the analysis copy and provenance before s1. Analyst checks scope, selects artefacts and examines tool assumptions in s1's 45 retained hours; missing provenance or unsupported artefacts require manual clarification. No structured activity or guilt label is assumed.
Review native forensic capabilities before new software; shares cover active analyst work and exclude parser runtime.
Zero upkeep because no changed tool or investigative process is introduced.
research_questions: Which artefact interpretations change after independent context or alternative explanations are examined?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Existing parser runtime is not analyst labour and all substantive investigation is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Capture system images or network settings as evidence

steps.what: Identify authorised system or network evidence and prepare capture
Create system images or capture network settings with approved evidence tools
Verify capture completeness, provenance and preservation handover

tasks.design: Keep acquisition preparation, active capture supervision and verification with the analyst using existing {OTHER} evidence tools. The software already performs imaging or settings capture; the proposal does not count that runtime as new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Capturing live or stored evidence requires an authorised scope and reliable provenance.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved acquisition tools already support technical capture.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete captures and changes caused or observed during acquisition.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst recognises limitations and documents the actual capture conditions.
tasks.altitude: Acquisition responsibility and verification remain unchanged.

reach.task: Receive an acquisition package with clear provenance
reach.learn: Trace target identity, capture conditions and exceptions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: evidence acquisition tools already automate technical capture, while scope, supervision and completeness checks remain analyst duties.

assumptions: Boundary is original environment acquisition, excluding later evidence duplication and ongoing preservation. Images and network-setting captures are alternative case types.

Analyst captures case ID, target identity, authority scope, acquisition method, time and destination in s1's 30 hours. Tool produces the acquired package and logs in s2; analyst checks identity, completeness and available integrity records in s3. Missing fields or failed acquisition require manual resolution, not an automatic verified-evidence flag.
Use native approved acquisition functions before custom code; shares exclude unattended imaging or transfer time.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or capture process is introduced.
research_questions: Which capture exceptions require additional analyst judgement beyond rerunning a tool?

already_counted.description: Capture preparation, active acquisition and verification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Existing acquisition runtime is excluded and all active analyst work retains its time.

tasks.short: Maintain knowledge of forensic and privacy requirements

steps.what: Study laws, regulations, policies and issuances relevant to digital forensics and information privacy

tasks.design: Retain critical study of authoritative material and approved policies in {DOCS}. Unclear national or case-specific applicability goes to the responsible legal owner; a summary is not a substitute for knowing the handling boundary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements and their applicability need careful reading in context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing authoritative sources support study without replacing professional understanding.
tasks.still_hard: Relating a changed issuance to actual evidence-handling or privacy circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst recognises when a legal question is unresolved rather than treating a summary as permission.

reach.learn: Identify the source text, jurisdiction and practical question

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forensic and privacy requirements depend on authoritative text and local applicability; professional understanding needs critical study.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining knowledge, excluding applying a case mandate and monitoring feeds on behalf of a compliance function.

Existing publishers and policy owners supply authoritative material; analyst evaluates its relevance within s1's retained time. No structured permission or knowledge-completed flag is assumed and unclear applicability is resolved manually.
Review existing reference access before new software; current retrieval runtime earns no saving.
Zero upkeep because no new process is proposed; national and case-specific rules are customer facts.
unknowns: Required professional learning and policy-update arrangements
research_questions: Which practical questions remain unclear after reading the current authoritative material?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. No professional understanding or applicability judgement is removed.

tasks.short: Write internal technical summaries of forensic findings

steps.what: Select findings and source references for the technical summary
Write a concise technical summary from the selected findings

loop.purpose: Draft a short technical summary without adding findings
loop.input: Analyst-selected findings, evidence references, limits and audience brief
loop.output: One concise summary with each claim tied to a supplied finding
loop.check: Analyst checks all assertions against the findings, preserves uncertainty and verifies that technical detail is neither misleadingly simplified nor omitted
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims, altered certainty or missing references return to manual writing with no automatic sharing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use a native summary template first; condensing technical findings into clear prose requires semantic drafting beyond field formatting

steps.what: Verify the summary and release the exact version to the technical audience

tasks.design: Use a bounded {DOCS} draft to condense selected completed findings for an internal technical audience. The analyst checks meaning, uncertainty and permitted recipients before sharing the exact version; formal legal reports and testimony remain separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Completed findings can require a second, shorter expression for technical handover.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can supply a concise first version for expert checking.
tasks.still_hard: A shorter explanation can accidentally strengthen a conclusion or omit a critical limitation.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which detail changes the interpretation and must remain visible.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass summary writing while technical meaning and release responsibility stay human.

reach.task: Understand the limits of an investigative finding
reach.learn: Distinguish evidence, inference and unresolved questions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound drafting can condense selected technical findings but requires expert checks for altered certainty and omissions.

assumptions: Boundary is internal technical summary writing, excluding substantive investigation, formal legal reporting and testimony. Allocate any reused drafting effort once.

Existing completed investigation supplies the findings. Analyst captures finding IDs, evidence versions, limitations, audience purpose and permitted recipients in s1's 40 hours; missing support is resolved manually or withheld. No automatically verified-finding label is assumed.
Try native summary templates before a model; existing document runtime earns no saving.
Use only locally approved access for case material; no automatic external sharing or filing is included.
unknowns: Whether a distinct technical summary is currently written
research_questions: Does reviewed condensation reduce writing time after counting corrections of omitted limits or altered certainty?

already_counted.description: Source and meaning checks of the draft

approvals.approved_version: Exact summary version, finding references, limitations and permitted internal recipients checked in s3; changes require fresh approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86, gross=14 and net=9 after five upkeep hours. Range assumes useful short-summary drafts; finding selection, meaning checks and release retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep acquisition, investigation and procedural knowledge with the analyst while reducing only verified first-pass technical-summary writing.
reach: Explain forensic limits clearly to technical case owners
role.ambitious_version: A forensic analyst who can give a clear technical handover without weakening the evidence or its limits.
